nature.en: Not an organization: countries with formal diplomatic relations with the Republic of China (Taiwan)
nature.zh: 非國際組織：與中華民國（台灣）維持正式外交關係的國家

purpose.en: Shows the countries that officially recognize the Republic of China (Taiwan) and exchange embassies with it instead of with the People's Republic of China.
purpose.zh: 顯示正式承認中華民國（台灣）、並與台灣（而非中華人民共和國）互設大使館的國家。

members.note: Eswatini (formerly Swaziland); Taiwan's only ally in Africa.
Holy See; Taiwan's only ally in Europe.
Taiwan's only ally in South America.

notes: Verified against Taiwan MOFA 'Diplomatic Allies' page (last updated 2026-11-02, read 2026-11-16): 12 allies - Marshall Islands, Palau, Tuvalu; Eswatini; Holy See; Belize, Guatemala, Haiti, Paraguay, St Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines. MOFA news of 14 Nov 2026 still calls Palau an ally.
No switches in 2025-2026; the last loss was Nauru (Jan 2024). Honduras (switched to Beijing 2023) has discussed restoring ties under President Asfura in 2026 but had not done so as of Nov 2026.
Taiwan (TWN) itself is not included as a member; highlight it separately on the map if desired.

'founded' = 1912, founding of the Republic of China (this is a list, not an organization). 'joined' = year current relations were established with the ROC (approximate for Guatemala, often cited as 1933).
